questions.question: If A is 95% of B, then what per cent of A is B?
questions.solution:
Given:

A is 95% of B

Concept Used:

x% of y = (x/100) × y

y% of x = (y/100) × x

Calculation:

According to the question, we have

A is 95% of B, 

⇒ A = (95/100)B

⇒ A/B = 19/20

⇒ B/A = 20/19

⇒ A = (19B/20)

Now, Required % = [B/(19B/20)] × 100

⇒ 105(5/19)%

**105(5/19) per cent of A is B.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

According to the question 

Let the value of B = 100

So, the value of A = 95 [ ∵ A is 95% of B ]

Now, We have to find what per cent of A is B

?% of A = B

⇒ (?/100) × 95 = 100

⇒ ? = (100 × 100)/95

⇒ ? = 105(5/19)%

questions.question: The marked price of mustard oil is 25% more than its cost price. At what percentage less than the marked price should it be sold to have no profit and no loss?
questions.solution:
Given:

The marked price of mustard oil = 25% more than its cost price

Concept Used:

Discount Percentage = (MP - SP)/MP * 100

Calculation:

Let the cost price of mustard oil be Rs 100x.

So, Marked price = 100x + 25% of 100x

Marked price = 100x + 25x

= 125x

For no profit, no loss, Selling price = Rs 100x

Excess price = 125x - 100x

= 25x 

Discount percentage offered on MP = (Excess Price / MP) × 100

Discount percentage offered on MP = (25x / 125x) × 100

⇒ 20%

Therefore, the discount percentage offered on the market price to have no profit and no loss is 20%.

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 25 days while B can complete the same work in 30 days. They work on alternate basis, starting with A. Both A and B follow this pattern for 5 days and then A leaves the work. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can complete the work in 25 days and 30 days.

A and B work alternatively = 5 days

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of (25, 30)

Total work = 150 unit

The efficiency of A = 150/25 = 6 unit/day

The efficiency of B = 150/30 = 5 unit/day

A and B work alternatively for 5 days, starting with A, then

⇒ 6 × 3 + 5 × 2

= 28 unit

Remaining work = 150 - 28

Remaining work = 122

The Time taken by B to complete the remaining work = 122/5

= 24(2/5) days

∴ The required days to complete the remaining work by 'B' are 24(2/5) days.

questions.question: 6²⁵ + 6²⁶ + 6²⁷ + 6²⁸ is divisible by :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take the lowest power common from the given expression:

⇒ 6²⁵(1 + 6¹ + 6² + 6³)

⇒ 6²⁵(1 + 6 + 36 + 216)

⇒ 6²⁵ × 259

Since 259 is a factor in the expanded form, the expression is exactly divisible by 259.

**∴ The correct answer is 259.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The expression is 6²⁵ + 6²⁶ + 6²⁷ + 6²⁸

**Calculation:**

To find the divisor, we simplify the expression by taking out the highest common factor among the terms.

⇒ 6²⁵ + 6²⁶ + 6²⁷ + 6²⁸

Factoring out 6²⁵ from all terms:

⇒ 6²⁵(1 + 6¹ + 6² + 6³)

Calculate the values of the powers of 6:

⇒ 6¹ = 6

⇒ 6² = 6 × 6 = 36

⇒ 6³ = 6 × 6 × 6 = 216

Substitute these values back into the parentheses:

⇒ 6²⁵(1 + 6 + 36 + 216)

Add the numbers inside the bracket:

⇒ 6²⁵(7 + 36 + 216)

⇒ 6²⁵(43 + 216)

⇒ 6²⁵(259)

This means the expression can be written as a multiple of 259. Therefore, it is perfectly divisible by 259.

**∴ The correct answer is 259.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Factoring Consecutive Powers

For any sum of consecutive powers like aⁿ + aⁿ⁺¹ + aⁿ⁺² + ..., you can always factor out the smallest power aⁿ. The remaining factor (1 + a + a² + ...) will directly give you the multiplier and reveal the divisors.

Properties of Divisibility

If a number N can be expressed in the form A × B, then N is completely divisible by both A and B independently, as well as by any factor of A or B.

Unit Digit of Powers of 6

The number 6 raised to any positive integer power always results in a unit digit of 6. This means 6ⁿ ends in 6 for all n ≥ 1.

questions.question: Two concentric circles are of radii 10 cm and 6 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle.
questions.solution:
**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1108ec6ffe4da0ebc6f7eff560f227c55a7412375e76c4b0524757736e500894.png] 

The perpendicular bisector of any chord passes through the centre of the circle,

OP ⊥ AB

In OPB, ∠OPB = 90⁰

PB² = OB² – OP²

⇒ PB² = 10² – 6²

⇒ PB² = 64

⇒ PB² = 8²

⇒ PB = 8 cm

OP bisects AB

⇒ AP = PB = 8 cm

questions.question: A train 900 m long is running at 108 km/h. How long will it take to clear a 900 m long platform completely?
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of train = 108 km/hr

Length of train = 900 meters

Length of platform = 900 meters

Formula Used:

Time = Distance/Speed

Calculation:

Speed of train in km/hr = 108 km/hr

Speed of train in m/sec = 108 × 5/18

⇒ 30 m/sec

Time taken by train to cross the platform:

As we know,

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ (900 + 900)/30

⇒ 1800/30

⇒ 60 sec

∴ The train will cross the platform in 60 seconds.

questions.question: A man, a boy and a woman can finish a work in 10 days, 15 days and 30 days, respectively. In how many days can the work be finished by a man, a woman and a boy when all of them work together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by Man to finish a work = 10 days

Time taken by Boy to finish a work = 15 days

Time taken by a woman to finish a work = 30 days

Concept:

Since man, woman and boy finish the same work at different times, calculate their efficiencies using the formula M₁D₁ = M₂D₂ and proceed.

Formula used:

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

Efficiency × No of days of work = Total Work

Calculation:

∵ 1 Man × 10 days = 1 Woman × 30 days = 1 Boy × 15 days

⇒ 2 Man = 6 Woman = 3 Boy

∴ The ratio of efficiency of a man, woman and boy = 3 ∶ 1 ∶ 2

Let the efficiency of man, woman and boy = 3a, a and 2a

Work done = 1 × 3a × 10 days

⇒ 30a

Together they will complete the work in:

⇒ 30a / (3a + a + 2a)

⇒ 5 days

**The work is finished by a man, a woman and a boy when all of them work together in 5 days.**

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 16, and (a² + b² + c²) = 90, find the value of (ab + bc + ca).
questions.solution:
**Given**

(a + b + c) = 16

(a2 + b2 + c2) = 90

Formula used

(a + b + c)² = (a2 + b2 + c2) + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation**

162 = 90 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 256 - 90 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 166 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 166/2

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 83

**The value is 83.**

questions.question: If {(3 sin θ – cos θ) / (cos θ + sin θ)} = 1, then the value of cot θ is:
questions.solution:
Given:

{(3Sinθ – Cosθ)/(Cosθ + Sinθ)} = 1

Calculation:

We have a trigonometric equation 

{(3Sinθ – Cosθ)/(Cosθ + Sinθ)} = 1

On dividing numerator and denominator by sin θ, we get

⇒ [{(3sinθ – cosθ)/Sinθ}/{(cosθ + sinθ)/sinθ}] = 1

⇒ {(3 – cotθ)/(cotθ + 1)} = 1

⇒ 3 – cotθ = 1 + cotθ

⇒ 2cotθ = 2

cotθ = 1

**The value is 1.**

questions.question: Two runners, Sony and Mony, start running on a circular track of length 200 m at speeds of 18 and 24 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. After how much time from the start will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sony and Mony, start running on a circular track of length 200 m at speeds of 18 and 24 km/h, respectively, in the same direction.

Formula used:

When two runners run on a circular track of length D m at a m/sec and b m/sec, respectively, in the same direction.

Time taken by them to meet for the first time at starting point on the track

⇒ LCM (D/a , D/b)

**Calculation:**

The speed of Sony (S₁) = 18 km/hr

⇒ 18 x (5/18) = 5 m/sec

The speed of Mony (S₂) = 24 km/hr

⇒ 24 x (5/18) = 20/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet for the first time at the starting point on track

⇒ LCM (D/a , D/b)

⇒ LCM (200/5, 200/(20/3))

⇒ LCM (40, 30)

 40 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 5

 30 = 2 x 3 x 5

⇒ LCM (40, 30) = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 5 = 120 seconds

**∴ The required time is 120 seconds.**

questions.question: What will be the remainder when (265)⁴⁰⁸¹+ 9 is divided by 266?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

(265)4081 + 9 is divisible by 266

⇒ (266 - 1)⁴⁰⁸¹+ 9

Now when divided by 266, 

⇒ (266 - 1)⁴⁰⁸¹over 266 + 9 over 266

Remainder from first fraction will be (- 1)⁴⁰⁸¹and + 9 from second fraction

Remainder as whole = - 1 + 9 = 8

**∴ Remainder when (265)4081+ 9 is divided by 266 is 8.**
